content: 1. Cefadroxil may increase the levels or effects of metolazone due to competition for renal tubular clearance involving acidic (anionic) drugs. The clinical significance of this interaction is currently unknown. 2. Cefadroxil may increase the levels or effects of nabumetone through a similar mechanism of acidic (anionic) drug competition for renal tubular clearance. The clinical significance remains unclear. 3.
